payout_quote: Through our 'Local Referring Local' program, if you are a current member and you refer a new member to open Maine's Best Checking Account or apply for a loan at market-leading rates, you will earn a $75 gift card to any local business of your choice in Cumberland or York County... You can refer ... up to 5 new members per year and receive up to $375 in gift cards annually.
steps: Be a current Town & Country Federal Credit Union (Maine) member.
Refer a friend, family member, co-worker, or neighbor to open Maine's Best Checking Account or apply for a loan at TCFCU's market-leading rates.
The referred person completes the new membership/account or loan application.
You earn a $75 gift card to any local business of your choice in Cumberland or York County (the referred person also gets a $75 local-business gift card).
You can refer up to 5 new members per year for up to $375 in gift cards annually.
catches: The reward is a $75 gift card usable only at a local business in Cumberland or York County, Maine - not cash, and only useful if you have access to those counties' businesses.
The program page is dated August 2024 and carries no stated end date; confirm the program is still running before relying on it.
Cap: 5 new members per year = $375 max in gift cards.
The friend must open Maine's Best Checking Account specifically, or apply for a loan.
biggest_catch: Your $75 is a gift card to a local Maine business, not cash - only valuable if you shop in Cumberland or York County - and the program page is from August 2024 with no stated end date.
eligibility: Current TCFCU members; referred persons must be new members opening Maine's Best Checking Account or applying for a loan.
timing: Official page does not state a payout window; gift cards are earned per qualifying referral.
